Activation Condition:
When the user uses any move once.
Deactivation Condition:
Cannot be deactivated.

Ignores the target’s raised stats. Lowers the target’s Defense and Speed by [Digit:1digit ] stat [EN:Qty S="rank" P="ranks" ]. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets. If the remaining MP for the user’s [Name:MoveId Idx="19660" ] is [Digit:1digit ] or more when attacking with this move, reduces those MP by [Digit:1digit ] and grants all of the following effects: Turns the field of play’s zone into a [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ]. (A [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] powers up [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="3" ]-type attacks.) Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by two.
